description: This header file declares functions related to quantized embedding bag operations, such as byte rowwise offsets and 4-bit rowwise offsets, within the 'at::native' namespace. It provides function prototypes for output tensors and relevant parameters used in quantized embedding bag computations.

methods.name: embedding_bag_byte_rowwise_offsets_out
methods.description: Computes the output of a byte quantized embedding bag with rowwise offsets, with parameters for output tensor, weight tensor, indices, offsets, scale flag, mode, pruning, per-sample weights, compressed index mapping, and inclusion of the last offset.

methods.name: embedding_bag_4bit_rowwise_offsets_out
methods.description: Computes the output of a 4-bit quantized embedding bag with rowwise offsets, similar parameters as above.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_unpack_out
methods.description: Unpacks a byte-packed quantized embedding weight tensor into a full tensor.
